summary: Eight-section about page led by a tall full-team photo, then mission and vision cards, two icon-card grids of reasons, two photo call-to-action bands, a two-column founder story and a red key-points band. Needs one team photo, a mission and a vision, 12 short reasons and a founder story.

sections.note: full-width group photo with a dark fade; small top strip with address and country switch; centered white title and a one-line lead; no breadcrumb, no buttons in the head
centered heading and one-line intro; two bordered cards side by side (mission, vision), each with a large line icon, a title, two or three bold-lead lines and a pill button
tinted band, centered heading and paragraph; three columns by two rows of white bordered cards, each with a small line icon, a title and two or three lines
photo band 480px with a dark overlay, centered two-line heading and one pill button
tinted band; three by two cards with grey line icons, then a last row of two wide boxes: a text box left and a video box right
second 480px photo band, one-line heading and one pill button (contact)
centered heading, then two columns of body text telling the founder story with bold lead sentences
brand-red band 280px: four columns, the first is a heading block, the other three are white tick lists
